After high school we started to hang out less due to college/work etc, but we still keep in touch here and there. We were both born and raised in Canada. Tim is Icelandic, Thor is his Icelandic name, apparently Icelandic people have an Icelandic name in addition to their Canadian birth name. I recently heard from my circle of friends that he is now demanding people call him Thor, if people don't then he is cutting ties with them as friends. Whats most likely going to happen is something like this: "Hey Tim! err.. I mean Thor." Knowing his short fuse he wont like this. Am i the asshole here?
